column1: # note: The 2025 Tax Computation Worksheet, for taxable income of $100,000 or more. The first row of each section reads "at least $100,000"; the rest read "over".

# note: The worksheet figures tax as (a) taxable income times (b) the multiplication amount, less (d) the subtraction amount. Each row holds base_tax = -(d) and of_excess_over = 0, so base_tax + rate x (income - of_excess_over) is that same figure.
# note: Section B covers married filing jointly and qualifying surviving spouse; its rows are repeated for both.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
